chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Do not take my grave as a qiblah or a masjid, for indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, cursed the Jews when they took the graves of their prophets as masajid."

key_terms.قَبْرِي: my grave; the burial place of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.قِبْلَةً: a direction of prayer toward which one turns in worship
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: a place of sajdah or worship

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about taking his grave as a qiblah or masjid?
ai.summary: This hadith forbids treating the grave of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله as a qiblah or as a place of prostrational worship. It warns against a form of excess in grave-veneration by citing how Allah cursed the Jews for taking the graves of their prophets as places of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Do not take my grave as a qibla (direction of prayer) or a mosque. Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious, cursed the Jews when they took the graves of their prophets as places of worship."
